rules.claim_boundary: exploratory diagnostics only; not empirical evidence, validation, holdout, production, trading authorization, or capital eligibility

eligibility.reentry: prohibited after the first emitted proposal

pre_entry_invalidation: entry timestamp outside the frozen entry window
raw or cost-adjusted entry at or below rounded stop

expected_failure_modes: one-bar volatility shock does not continue
breakout is a temporary liquidity sweep
modeled costs and adverse selection exceed any gross effect

indicators.atr20: Frozen Wilder ATR20 over consecutive completed regular bars; seed is the arithmetic mean of the first 20 true ranges and later values are (19*prior_ATR+TR)/20; gaps reset the series.
indicators.breakout_reference: maximum high of the exact 15 completed bars immediately preceding the expansion bar; equal highs use the earliest timestamp
indicators.same_clock_volume: trigger-bar volume divided by the median volume at the identical minute label from exactly the 20 most recent prior eligible sessions

lifecycle.gap_through: long stop exits at min(open,stop); long target exits at max(open,target)
lifecycle.same_bar_precedence: gap stop, intrabar stop, gap target, intrabar target, timeout, session liquidation
lifecycle.session_exit: earlier of the 120th held bar or 15:55 completed-bar close; early close uses the fifth completed bar before scheduled close

numeric_semantics.cent_rounding: convert binary64 through its shortest round-trip decimal string before floor or ceiling quantization to 0.01
numeric_semantics.operation_rounding: round to nearest ties to even

setup.breakout: expansion close strictly above the unrounded prior-15-bar high
setup.continuation: trigger-bar close strictly above the unrounded expansion-bar high
setup.expansion_atr_reference: ATR20 at the completed bar immediately preceding the expansion bar
setup.expansion_bar: the completed bar immediately preceding the trigger bar
setup.expansion_direction: expansion close strictly above expansion open
setup.signal_timestamp: exclusive end of the completed trigger bar

stop.unrounded: minimum low of expansion bar and trigger bar

target.rule: cost-adjusted entry plus 2 times initial per-share risk

tie_breaking: earliest prior-15-bar high timestamp for equal highs
